example.name: Pre-call filtering
example.description: Here are a few examples of useful patterns:
example.snippet:
# exclude Go tests and test data Ignore(["**_test.go", "**/testdata/**"])
# exclude binaries Ignore(["bin"])
# exclude Python dependencies Ignore(["**/.venv", "**/__pycache__"])
# exclude Node.js dependencies Ignore(["**/node_modules"])
# exclude Git metadata Ignore([".git", "**/.gitignore"])
